svg.title: A knot, one move at a time
svg.desc: Before, during, and after a three-strand move in the conormal graph. At halfway the three graph heights agree, with slopes 15/8, zero, and minus 15/8. The reconstructed original points stay distinct on one tangent line. The full checked sequence has 6,367 moves between the positive eleven-strand endpoint braids, each with 106 crossings. Graph axes have different units; the local point diagram uses equal coordinate scales.

g.text: A knot, one move at a time.
Three strands can meet in the tangent-line graph while their original points stay apart.
At halfway, distance agrees. The three slopes do not.
Slope places each point along its tangent line.
Local reconstruction · common distance offset 25 · equal x/y scales
6,367 checked moves: 5,450 independent swaps · 722 three-strand moves · 195 cut moves
A positive-front route between the endpoint words. The full plane event list is not counted.
